name: Reaction Time
description: Test your reaction speed against other players.

name: Guess The Time
description: Try to guess the time as accurately as possible.
win_condition: Closest guess to the actual time throughout 3 rounds.
lose_condition: Furthest guess from the actual time throughout 3 rounds.

name: Impostor Color
description: Out of 12 bottles, 10 are green and 2 are red.
win_condition: Avoid choosing the red colored bottle
lose_condition: The one who chooses the red colored bottle.

name: Word Memory Challenge
description: Random number of words will be shown one by one and will ask the players what word was shown in a random order.
win_condition: Correctly recall the target word throughout the 3 rounds.
lose_condition: Incorrectly recall the target word in a round.

name: Avoid Similar Answer
description: A request will be shown and players will try to give their answers not equal to the game's answer.
win_condition: Successfully avoid giving the same answer as the game's answer throughout the 3 rounds.
lose_condition: Give the same answer as the game's answer in a round, wrong, or no answer.

name: Full Water
description: Each player will take turns to fill a maximum of 5 mL of water into an empty container.
win_condition: Successfully fill the container without exceeding the maximum limit.
lose_condition: Exceeds the maximum limit of the container.

name: Type It
description: Players must type the given phrase as quickly and accurately as possible within the given time.
win_condition: Successfully type the given phrase accurately within the time limit throughout the 3 rounds.
lose_condition: Fail to finish typing the given phrase within the time limit in a round.
